sourceDocuments.title: Grid Frequency Instability in the Nigerian 330kV National Grid
sourceDocuments.text: Cascading grid collapses occur when sudden generation trip-offs in thermal power plants exceed the spinning reserve capacity of hydro stations in Kainji and Jebba.

studentDocument.text: Perturb and observe maximum power point tracking algorithms dynamically match solar array impedance to battery charge controllers under fluctuating solar irradiance.
